create.name: Instituto Kriya Yoga
create.bio:
The Instituto Kriya Yoga is the Brazilian branch of the Kriya Yoga mission founded by Paramahamsa Hariharananda and now led by Paramahamsa Prajnanananda, and it serves as the mother centre for Latin America. Its monks first lived in a house in Mogi das Cruzes from 2012, moved twice within São Paulo, and in October 2015 opened its city ashram, called the Templo do Amor Divino: a large house among trees in a quiet part of the city, chosen by Prajnanananda himself, who came from India to inaugurate it. A rural ashram in Mogi has since followed.

Guided meditations at the ashram are for people initiated in the lineage, and the institute holds initiation weekends in São Paulo and other Brazilian cities, each preceded by a public talk. Several programmes are open to everyone: a Monday satsang on spirituality and meditation at the São Paulo ashram and on Zoom, a Bhagavad Gita study every Wednesday that has run online since 2014, a Spanish-language satsang, and Sunday readings from the lives of the Kriya masters with occasional interfaith guests.

free_resources.title: Aulas on-line: satsang and Bhagavad Gita study
free_resources.description: Free weekly classes open to all on Zoom: a Monday satsang with short guided meditation (also in person at the São Paulo ashram), a Spanish satsang on Tuesdays, Bhagavad Gita study on Wednesdays and Sunday readings on the lives of the Kriya masters, mostly led by Swami Ishwarananda (in Portuguese).

free_resources.title: Palestras e aulas online
free_resources.description: Transcribed talks by the lineage's monks, free to read in Portuguese, beginning with Swami Atmavidyananda on the art of forgiveness.
